title: ProvQuotation
description: Rootless facet — PROV Quotation: "the repeat of (some or all of) an entity, such as text or image, by someone who may or may not be its original author"; "an entity was derived from a preceding entity by copying, or 'quoting', some or all of it." A kind of derivation relation, expressed in PROV-DM as wasDerivedFrom with prov:type='prov:Quotation' and carrying the derivation structure (§5.2.1); PROV defines no quotation-specific attributes. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.2.3 Quotation; PROV-O prov:wasQuotedFrom, prov:Quotation ⊑ prov:Derivation.

id.description: Optional identifier for this derivation relation (PROV-DM §5.7.1: two derivations are equal if they have the same identifier).

entity.description: The preceding entity that was quoted (PROV-DM §5.2.3). Must be identifiable (§5.7.1).

activity.description: The activity using and generating the entities of this derivation (PROV-DM §5.2.1, a, optional).

generation.description: The generation involving the generated entity and the activity (PROV-DM §5.2.1, g2, optional; Generation is a Component 1 concept, referenced here as a member of the derivation expression). Joint-presence discipline with activity/usage is a PROV-CONSTRAINTS rule, out of shape scope.

usage.description: The usage involving the used entity and the activity (PROV-DM §5.2.1, u1, optional; Usage is a Component 1 concept, referenced here as a member of the derivation expression).

attributes.description: Optional set of attribute-value pairs with additional information about this derivation (PROV-DM attrs; reserved PROV attributes per §5.7.2 — prov:label, prov:type — plus application-specific attributes, PROV-DM's extensibility point, §6).
